answer: Each bonded identity is a vertex in the accountability graph. If evidence links k identities to coordinated equivocation, pairwise penalties aggregate as O(k²), so splitting an operator across keys does not dilute liability. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, exp(αk), through escrow slashing and asymmetric depreciation. A sybil jetty cannot shelter stake, and nectar-like rewards for proliferating keys are outweighed by the risk.
